title: DISAPPOINTED!
text: DISAPPOINTED!. I love the weight and style of this knife, but not even 2 weeks after receiving this, it's showing rust and spots (see pic). Stainless?? Nope, not THIS blade! It stinks because I've had this knife in a bigger size, same maker (supposedly), and no problems with that one!

product_metadata.title: RADA Cutlery Cook’s Utility Knife – Stainless Steel Blade With Black Steel Resin Handle, 8-5/8 Inch, 2 Pack
features: USEFUL MID-SIZE KNIFE – The Cook’s Utility Knife handles like a paring knife while offering the versatility of a larger knife. There are not many tasks it can’t take on. The blade measures 4-3/4 inches and has an overall length of 8-5/8 inches. Pack of 2.

STAINLESS STEEL BLADE – The blade on the utility knife has a rounded tip for slicing, dicing and scoring. It is made of surgical grade, T420 high carbon stainless steel that is hand sharpened making it ultra sharp.

DISHWASHER SAFE HANDLE - The handle on this utility knife is comprised of a black stainless steel resin that can be washed in the dishwasher. Hand washing fine cutlery is recommended but the handle on this knife is dishwasher tolerant.

AMERICAN MADE KNIFE – Rada Mfg. Co. is located in Waverly, Iowa and has been manufacturing cutlery in the USA since 1948. Our mission is all about “providing our customers the best value of kitchen knives for their dollar.”
HASSLE-FREE LIFETIME GUARANTEE – We stand by our craftsmanship. Rada Mfg. Co. will replace any product manufactured by our company returned to us due to defects in material or workmanship.
description: The Cooks Utility is a smaller version of the popular Cooks Knife. The Cooks Utility gives you more control over your cutting tasks. Its handle provides more leverage and its blade allows a rocking motion for dicing or mincing. Blade 4 3/4 inches, overall 8 1/2 inches. Package of 2 Cooks Utility Knives. Rada cutlery is made of surgical quality, high carbon stainless steel. Hollow-ground blades ensure a precision concave surface for maximum edge retention and sharpness.
